_README: The page title asserts 180 points, so the page counts these items at build time and
renders the real number. If you add or remove an item the count on the page changes
with it, and scripts/gate.mjs fails the build if the rendered count stops matching
the number in the title tag. A claim in a title tag is still a claim.
These are inspection points, not sourced statistics — what a surveyor checks, not what
anything costs. Prices and rules live on the sibling pages and carry sources.
